definitions.gloss: cherry blossom blizzard, shower of cherry petals
definitions.explanation: The spectacle of cherry blossom petals falling thickly through the air, resembling a snowstorm. A poetic image of late spring when the blossoms scatter.

examples.japanese: {桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The shower of cherry petals is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いて{桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}が{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The wind blew and cherry petals swirled up into the air.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}の{桜|さくら}{並木|なみき}を{歩|ある}いていたら、{見事|みごと}な{桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: While walking along the row of cherry trees in the park, I was enveloped in a magnificent shower of petals.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {桜|さくら} (cherry blossom) and {吹雪|ふぶき} (blizzard, snowstorm). This poetic image compares the dense fluttering of fallen cherry petals to a snowstorm. It describes the period just after full bloom when petals begin to scatter ({散|ち}る). Commonly evoked in literature, song lyrics, and seasonal descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}が{舞|ま}う: cherry petals dance/flutter
- {桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}に{包|つつ}まれる: to be enveloped in cherry petals
- {見事|みごと}な{桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}: a magnificent petal shower
